currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann SNP-Analysen für Diagnostik/Variation auswerten.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can evaluate SNP analyses for diagnostics/variation.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Ein SNP variiert eine einzelne orientierte DNA-Position; ein Genotyp verlangt ausreichende qualitätsgeprüfte Allelsignale. Eine Markerassoziation ist weder kausaler Nachweis noch individuelle Diagnose.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: A SNP varies at one oriented DNA position; genotype calls require sufficient quality-checked allele signals. Marker association is neither evidence of causation nor an individual diagnosis.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person identifiziert die G/A-Position, begründet GA/GG beziehungsweise einen unklaren Befund mit den gelieferten QC-Regeln und berechnet beobachtete Gruppenhäufigkeiten samt absolutem und relativem Unterschied.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner identifies the G/A position, justifies GA/GG or an inconclusive result using supplied QC rules and calculates observed group frequencies with absolute and relative differences.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei neuen R-Signalen und Rückwärtsstrangdaten ordnet sie die Genotypen neu zu; bei einer frischen U-Schichtung prüft sie eine Störfaktorerklärung statt eine alte Markerdiagnose zu übernehmen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: With new R signals and reverse-strand data the learner revises genotype calls; with fresh U stratification the learner tests a confounding explanation rather than retaining an earlier marker diagnosis.

rationale: KEEP current concise DE/EN SNP interpretation goal and whole Native4 page. I read both complete bilingual cases including QC, controls, solutions, rubric and transfer. Independent checks: P=GA, Q=GG, original R unresolved with 10 signals; remeasured R=24/50 G and26/50 A qualifies GA; reverse30C/0T corresponds GG. Case2 illustrative P_A=GA/P_N=GG cannot classify all400; that grouping is explicitly supplied. Rates15%/5%, ratio3 and10 percentage points become20%/20% in high-U and0 observed in low-U, so independent marker causation remains unproved. HTML/PDF show the same forward-oriented single-position difference, quality question and Marker≠Diagnose without clipping. Bioinformatics remains an external prerequisite and the terminal exam remains an external successor. The short description does not claim actual clinical validation. Existing bounded P-v2 coverage is sufficient, E1/G1/needs_human_review remains unchanged. Historical HE extraction literalness and whole source/course duties are not approved by this review.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann genetische Risiken mit Populationsdaten und Stammbäumen abschätzen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can estimate genetic risks using population data and pedigrees.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Genetisches Modellrisiko verbindet die bedingte Genotypwahrscheinlichkeit aus einem Stammbaum mit einer geeigneten Trägerreferenz und der Allelweitergabe; Nichtbetroffenheit beweist bei Rezessivität nicht AA.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Modeled genetic risk combines pedigree-conditional genotype probabilities with a suitable carrier reference and allele transmission; being unaffected in a recessive model does not establish AA.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person begründet Aa×Aa und Aa×AA, wählt die passende statt einer angereicherten Bezugsgruppe und leitet 1/80 beziehungsweise 1/60 aus den ausdrücklich gegebenen Bedingungen ab.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner explains Aa×Aa and Aa×AA, selects an appropriate rather than enriched reference group and derives 1/80 or 1/60 under explicitly supplied conditions.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Ein neuer bestätigter Partnerbefund oder eigener AA-Befund ersetzt frühere Unsicherheit; bekannte Genotypen und unabhängige Geburten begründen keinen notwendigen Ausgleich früherer Kinder.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: A new confirmed partner genotype or personal AA result replaces previous uncertainty; known genotypes and independent births imply no balancing of previous children.

rationale: KEEP current bilingual population/pedigree estimation goal. I independently derive case1 (50/1000)×1/4=1/80=1.25%; case2 P(Aa|unaffected)=2/3, suitable M90/900=1/10, resulting1/60≈1.67%, not1/2 or enriched N300/600. Fresh partner Aa gives25% for each next birth despite three unaffected children. Confirmed own AA instead excludes aa in the explicitly mutation-/error-free model and replaces, rather than multiplies,2/3 uncertainty. Both whole bilingual cases/rubrics demand justified data selection and fresh individual evidence. I actually viewed whole current HTML/PDF: exactly20 population symbols,1 colored, Aa versus unknown partner and unknown-sex child, model question without a claimed numerical child risk. Carrier meaning comes from the supplied case, not an invented colored-symbol disease legend. Current description, pedigree prerequisite and exam successor remain coherent. P-v2 synthetic E1/G1 is retained, no real-family diagnosis, medical zero-risk claim or general Hardy-Weinberg assumption. Historical HE literal-source and whole course claims stay open.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann polygenetische und multifaktorielle Vererbung erklären.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain polygenetic and multifactorial inheritance.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Mehrere segregierende Gene können gemeinsam einen Phänotyp beeinflussen; multifaktorielle Ausprägung verbindet genetische Beiträge mit Umwelt, ohne Genotyp oder Erkrankung aus einem Phänotyp sicher festzulegen.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Multiple segregating genes can jointly affect phenotype; multifactorial outcomes combine genetic contributions and environment without uniquely identifying genotype or certain disease from phenotype.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person konstruiert die Gametenkombinationen und additive Verteilung, erklärt gleiche Messfarbe bei verschiedenen Genotyp-/Umweltkombinationen und trennt vorgegebene Erkrankungswahrscheinlichkeit von individueller Gewissheit.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner constructs gamete combinations and their additive distribution, explains identical measured colour from different genotype/environment combinations and distinguishes supplied disease probabilities from individual certainty.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Für eine neue Kreuzung leitet sie die Verteilung neu ab; bei einem nur B-abhängigen Umweltbeitrag prüft sie die Gen-Umwelt-Wechselwirkung und nennt notwendige unabhängige Daten vor einer realen Anwendung.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: For a new cross the learner derives a new distribution; with a B-dependent environmental contribution the learner evaluates gene-environment interaction and identifies independent evidence needed before real application.

rationale: KEEP bilingual explanation goal, not a disguised independent list of competencies: polygenic/multifactorial are the two related mechanisms contrasted in the same inheritance explanation. I read whole two bilingual profiles/cases/solutions/rubrics/fresh transfers. Own arithmetic: AaBb×AaBb gives pigment0–4 in1:4:6:4:1; AABb/N0 andAaBb/N1 both3. New Aabb×aaBb yields0:1:2=1:2:1, shifted observed values underN1 with unchanged DNA. Synthetic Z formula10+5k+20E produces30/25/20/10% versus50/45/40/30%; B-dependent fresh interaction keepsAABB50% and changesaabb30→10%. Real clinical prediction, heritability and a universal plant mechanism are explicitly excluded. Whole HTML/PDF clearly show two homologous locus pairs and separate environment arrows into a labelled plant model, no causal DNA rewriting. Existing P-v2 coverage and unchanged A/M atomic/no_memory_needed decision fit concept explanation and modeling, not a recall quota. No whole HE Q1.3/official wording/source duty approval follows.

currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Methoden der genetischen Familienberatung gegeneinander abgrenzen, Vor- und Nachteile bewerten und in Entscheidungssituationen begründete Entscheidungen auch aus ethischer Sicht treffen.
currentDescriptionEn: The learner can distinguish methods of genetic family counseling, evaluate advantages and disadvantages, and make justified decisions in decision situations, including from an ethical perspective.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Stammbaumgespräch, gezielter Variantentest und breites Panel beantworten verschiedene Fragen; methodischer Nutzen und Unsicherheit werden zusammen mit freiwilliger informierter Wahl und familiären Informationsgrenzen bewertet.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Pedigree counseling, targeted variant testing and a broad panel answer different questions; usefulness and uncertainty are evaluated together with voluntary informed choice and family-information boundaries.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die lernende Person vergleicht konkrete M1–M3-Vor- und Nachteile, begründet eine vertretbare Wahl anhand der gelieferten monogenen beziehungsweise multifaktoriellen Situation und trennt Befund, Prognose und persönliche Lebensentscheidung.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner compares concrete M1–M3 advantages and drawbacks, justifies a defensible choice in supplied monogenic or multifactorial situations and distinguishes a finding, prognosis and personal life choice.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Veränderte Informationswünsche führen zu einer neu begründeten Methodenwahl; eine unklare Variante verlangt offene wissenschaftliche Klärung statt sichere Diagnose oder automatische Mitteilung an Verwandte.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: Changed information preferences require a newly justified method choice; an uncertain variant requires unresolved scientific clarification rather than certain diagnosis or automatic disclosure to relatives.

rationale: KEEP current whole bilingual ethical counseling competency. Method distinction and pros/cons are evidence for one justified ethical decision, not independently completed unrelated skills. I read both complete bilingual cases, solutions/rubrics and fresh changes. Monogenic D/d×d/d gives1/2 transmission only; targetedM2 matches a voluntary bounded question, whileM1/postponement can also be justified andM3 has no supplied added benefit. In multifactorial case4%/2% gives ratio2 and2 percentage points, not personal calibrated4% or Mendelian1/2; without a known familial variant M2 is unsupported. Changed preference means M1/postponement, and VUS without new function/clinical data is no confirmed cause. No forced test, correct life choice, real panel or law is assumed. Whole HTML/PDF display equal method options, readable informed-choice label and a calm empty-table conversation. Pedigree/criteria prerequisites and exam successor remain correct. BY direct full methods/ethical-decision operator is compatible; MV/SN/ST/TH partial contributions do not prove every source duty, SN statutory coverage or TH SekII applicability. Those unchanged source/course boundaries remain separate from this bounded D/P keep.
